title: AI Rescues a Terrible Website
script: I made this website bad on purpose. AI gets twenty minutes to rescue it. The copy stays. Every working feature stays. Only the design can change. The timer starts when I submit the prompt, not when the agent begins editing. Here is the result beside the original, at the same viewport. [VISIBLE_IMPROVEMENT]. [PRESERVED_FEATURES_AND_REMAINING_PROBLEM]. Which version would you actually use?
timingStatus: Estimated silent editorial timings. Refit scenes and caption timestamps to the unchanged voice-over when supplied.
concept: Twenty-minute redesign without changing copy or removing functionality.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: I made this website bad on purpose. AI gets twenty minutes to rescue it.
Same copy. Same features. Twenty minutes to improve the design.
A beautiful redesign still fails if the button breaks.
strongestHook: I made this website bad on purpose. AI gets twenty minutes to rescue it.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Twenty-minute redesign without changing copy or removing functionality. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Build an original deliberately ugly but functional landing page with fixed copy, signup validation, FAQ and navigation. Snapshot baseline. Give 20 minutes from prompt submission to verified finish. Preserve all copy, links and functional checks. Capture desktop and 390px mobile before/after at identical scroll positions. Audit readability, spacing, hierarchy, form behavior, FAQ and navigation; record regressions and final time.
evidenceRequirements: Capture constraints, baseline and final; report actual improvements and failures.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Twenty Minute Rescue” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: Which version would you actually use?
instagramCaption: AI Rescues a Terrible Website. Twenty-minute redesign without changing copy or removing functionality. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. Which version would you actually use?
tiktokCaption: AI Rescues a Terrible Website. BEFORE OR AFTER?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
